question: What alternative name and ritual suitability can this structure possess?
premises: The structure may be called pleasing to Viṣṇu by name.
The structure can be worthy of all gods.
Its status is expressed as a possible designation.
inference: The same structure may be named pleasing to Viṣṇu and deemed worthy of all gods.
plain_english: This structure may be called pleasing to Viṣṇu and should be worthy of all the gods.
